_comment: Guía del robot A.R.I.A. (scripts/core/guide.gd). Textos para niños de 7 a 12 años, en inglés (los ve el jugador). Cada lección se enseña UNA vez cuando ocurre su 'trigger': 'scene:<ruta>' al entrar a esa escena, 'task:<id>' al completar una tarea, 'all_tasks' al terminar las tareas del día 1 y 'sol:2' al empezar el día 2. {player} = nombre del tripulante, {role} = su profesión, {perk1}/{perk2} = sus ventajas. 'image' es una captura del juego en assets/ui/guide/ (la genera tools/build_guide_shots.py).

pages.text: Hi {player}! I'm A.R.I.A., your robot helper. I'll stay with you during your first day on Mars. Ready?
YOUR MISSION: stay safe for 60 sols (a sol is one day on Mars) and finish 100% of the RESEARCH. That's how you WIN!
Look at the top right corner. These bars tell you how you are doing. Keep FOOD and FITNESS high. Keep TIREDNESS and RADIATION low.
Be careful! The mission ends if the BATTERY or FOOD reaches 0, or if TIREDNESS or RADIATION reaches 100.
Time flies on Mars: 1 real minute is 1 hour in the game. The clock is next to the battery.
Inside the base, move the mouse over a door and CLICK to go in. The yellow arrow at the bottom takes you outside.
Oh no! The storm broke our SOLAR PANELS. Without them, the battery will run out. Let's fix them first! Click the yellow arrow to go outside.
This is AP-1, our base on Mars. Walk with W A S D (or the arrow keys). Hold SHIFT to run.
Walk to a door and press E to go in. Here is the map: the STATION, the SOLAR PANELS, the ICE EXCAVATOR, the ROVER and the ROCKET.
Outside, RADIATION goes up faster. Do your job and go back in! Now walk to the SOLAR PANELS (top right) and press E.
This is the solar power building. SOLAR FIELD: clean the panels and change the broken ones. POWER ROOM: turn machines on and off to save energy.
Click SOLAR FIELD and fix the broken panels. Changing a panel uses a little energy, but it's worth it!
Great job, {player}! The panels make energy again. Clean panels give 12 energy every hour. The base uses about 8.
Mars dust makes the panels dirty EVERY DAY. Dirty panels make less energy. Clean them once a day!
Next, let's make food. Go back to the STATION and enter the GREENHOUSE.
Potatoes are our food! Follow the steps: 1. PLANT the seeds. 2. WATER them every day. 3. HARVEST them after 8 sols.
If you forget to water them, you get fewer potatoes. After 4 days without water, they die! Click the SEED POTATOES to start.
Nice planting! Now click the WATER TANK and water the sprouts. Click when the water is in the GREEN zone.
Your potatoes are growing! Next: the GYM. On Mars there is less gravity, so your muscles get weak. Exercise once every day!
Click the TREADMILL. Jump over the rocks with SPACE and duck under the meteors with the DOWN arrow until the bar is full.
WOW! You finished all the jobs for today. Now let me tell you how to WIN the mission.
RESEARCH is in 3 places: AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9. At each one you take a SAMPLE. At AP-1 you use the ICE EXCAVATOR.
AP-8 and AP-9 are far away. Drive the ROVER there. Before you go: check the rover, fix it and pack food.
Bring each sample to the WORK ROOM in the station. The analysis takes 3 sols and works alone while you do other things.
STORMS: I will warn you before a storm comes. If it is strong, stay inside. When it ends, fix what broke.
Your superpowers as the {role}: {perk1}. {perk2}.
Every day: eat 3 times, sleep about 8 hours at night, clean the panels, water the potatoes and exercise. Visit the INFIRMARY if radiation gets high.
That's all! I'll stay here in the corner. CLICK ME anytime and I'll tell you what to do next. Good luck, {player}!
Good morning, {player}! Day 1 is done. The dust made the solar panels dirty, so clean them today. And don't forget your potatoes!
